d:
A large, quadrupedal beast resembling a prehistoric wolf. Shaggy, thick charcoal-black fur covering the entire body, with a long, bushy tail of the same color. Small, glowing sulfur-yellow eyes and a wide snout with sharp white fangs. Four paws each with four thick black claws. Two curved, obsidian-black horns protrude from the forehead.
BODY COLOR: charcoal-black
